inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: FY2026 AR note 12 weighted basic 3,878.1m + 1.0m dilutive options = 3,879.1m; year-end issued ~3,877.7m + options ~1.0m = 3,878.7m used. Held FLAT (SBC expensed in flows). The qualitative analysis reports ~21.2m shares repurchased for cancellation since the June-2025 mandate, but the FY2026 AR (note 28(a)) states no repurchase during FY2026 or FY2025, so any buybacks fall after 31-Mar-2026 and are not yet verified against an HKEX monthly return; not netted (~0.5% upside to per-share values if confirmed).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 AR cash flow statement line 3434 'Equity-settled share-based payments expense' HK$7,353k; no net-share-settlement tax line (HK market, options). SBC-zero market in practice (<0.05% of revenue).
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z regular close (HKEX), Yahoo Finance chart API
inputs.wacc_rationale: HKD flows (HKD pegged to USD; operating economics RMB/USD/EUR). Risk-free ~3.6% (10y HKGB/UST), ERP 6.0%, beta ~1.1 for a China-weighted discretionary manufacturer -> CoE ~10.2%; gearing on market cap is modest (net debt incl. leases ~HK$1.5bn vs ~HK$8.8bn market cap), after-tax cost of debt ~3% -> WACC ~9.5-10%. 10.0% used, identical across scenarios: China-property, tariff and governance risk is charged in the bear flows and the 30% bear weight, not stacked as a WACC premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A) leases as debt: lease liabilities HK$599.8m (74.3 current + 525.5 non-current; jumped from 172.9m on HK$467.5m acquired with Gainline's Mississippi plants) are inside total_debt; lease principal is NOT deducted from flows; ROU depreciation sits inside da_pct and ~0.5pp of revenue of lease renewal is carried inside capex_pct. total_debt = bank and other borrowings 4,240.3 + lease liabilities 599.8 = 4,840.1 (FY2026 AR note 34(b) net debt table).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (100%); NCI deducted once in equity_bridge at book value HK$1,017.6m (FY2026 balance sheet). NCI share of profit FY2026 HK$91.2m (4.8% of consolidated NPAT); book ~11x that, close to a market-type multiple for the stake.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, per dcf-methods routing row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical' (furniture manufacturer, high cyclicality to China housing and US tariffs) plus owner-fcf-adaptations (leases, NCI, SBC-zero, HKD WACC). First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY entry). EBITDA margin paths are ex interest income: reported FY2026 EBITDA 3,096.9 includes interest income 122.2 on the HK$3.3bn gross cash pile, which is netted in the bridge, so it is stripped from the margin (FY2026 margin ex interest 18.1%; FY2025 19.1%; FY2024 18.9%; FY2023 17.8%). interest_income field left 0 because the group is net debt, so the last_fcf convention does not strip it; the stripping is done in the margin path instead. Reported FY2026 FCF (OCF 2,379.8 - capex 1,310.8) is depressed by a ~HK$0.8bn build in properties under development (157 -> 951), which is why those properties are added in the bridge rather than in the flows. FY2027 revenue includes a full year of Gainline Group (Southern Motion/Fusion, closed 18-Dec-2025): AR note 36 pro forma FY2026 revenue HK$17,808m vs reported 16,429m, i.e. ~HK$1.4bn of incremental annualised revenue at low margin (pro forma profit +~HK$97m). Buyback: no repurchases in FY2025-FY2026 per AR; flat count is a modelling convention the company was not funding through FY2026 (SBC is immaterial anyway). Price is at the 52-week low after a steady slide from ~HK$5.0 (Feb-2026) with a sharp ~25% leg in Sep-Oct 2026; no filing in the folder explains the last leg, and H1 FY2027 (six months to 30-Sep-2026) results are due ~late November 2026 -- replace the anchors then.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: revenue/EPS CAGRs (~0 to -2%) plus Gainline consolidation, NOT equity CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (5.7-7.1%) diverges far more than 30% from revenue (0 to -1.8%) and EPS (-1.5%) CAGRs: book grows because ~50% of profit is retained while revenue and earnings have gone sideways since the FY2022 peak (HK$21.5bn). Equity CAGR rejected as the growth anchor.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC (SBC < HK$19m every year, so owner and reported CAGRs coincide). FCF is extremely lumpy (FY2019 45m, FY2020 1,842m, FY2023 2,498m, FY2025 2,585m, FY2026 1,069m) because of working-capital swings and plant build-outs; 3yr and 5yr FCF CAGRs are endpoint artefacts. FY2018-FY2026 average owner-FCF margin ~8.1% of revenue.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 +4%: full-year Gainline (~+8% of FY2026 revenue) offset by ~-4% organic (China -6/-7% continuing, North America flat under Section 232 duties). FY2028 +1% as the January-2027 tariff step-up (25%->30% upholstered) bites; then low-single-digit recovery as China replacement demand stabilises, fading to 2% terminal.
base.margin_rationale: FY2026 ex-interest EBITDA margin 18.1%; FY2027 16.8% for Gainline mix dilution (~9% EBITDA margin business at ~10% of revenue, -0.9pp) and a full year of Section 232 duties (FY2026 had ~half a year at HK$283m). Recovers to 17.5%, below the FY2024-FY2025 ~19% as China price competition persists.
base.capex_rationale: 6.0% of revenue incl. ~0.5pp right-of-use renewals (lease treatment A); below the FY2018-FY2026 average ~7.5% which carried the Vietnam/Mexico/Ukraine plant build-outs, above D&A 4.3%. Management states no material new investment planned for FY2027.
base.wc_rationale: Net operating working capital (inventory + trade and other receivables - trade and other payables - contract liabilities) ~HK$2.5bn = ~15% of revenue; growth consumes cash.
base.tax_rationale: FY2026 weighted applicable rate 19.1%, cash tax paid 432/2,353 PBT = 18.4%; 19.5% used (PRC 15% high-tech/25% mix, Vietnam, US 21%).

scenario_narratives.base: China (56% of revenue) keeps shrinking mid-single digits through FY2027 as the property slump and small-brand price competition persist, then stabilises on replacement demand and the 15th Five-Year Plan consumption push without a real recovery. Gainline adds ~HK$1.4bn of US-made revenue at a thin margin, partly insulating North America from Section 232 duties, but the January-2027 step-up still costs margin. EBITDA margin settles ~17.5% (ex interest income), a point and a half below FY2024-FY2025, and growth fades to 2%.
scenario_narratives.bull: Management's call that the China sofa market 'has bottomed' proves right: online channels and the First Class Cheers lifestyle upgrade lift same-store productivity after the 1,000-store cull, and China returns to low-single-digit growth. Gainline's US plants plus the five-business-unit North American reorganisation win share from import-dependent competitors as tariffs rise, and Europe/emerging markets keep growing. Margins return to the FY2024-FY2025 ~19% band; capex stays light with no new plant programme.
scenario_narratives.bear: No turn in China housing: PRC revenue falls another 15-20% over three years as homogenised recliner competition crushes ASPs, while the Section 232 step-up to 30% in January 2027 and possible further reciprocal tariffs hit the ~28% North American business harder than Gainline's small US base can offset. Gainline integration disappoints (first US manufacturing at this scale). Revenue declines in FY2028-FY2029, EBITDA margin falls to ~14.5-15% (FY2022-trough-type levels), and unhedged RMB/EUR/UAH translation adds noise. Terminal growth 1%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default: China housing has no visible turn, the Section 232 step-up is scheduled for January 2027, and the share price has halved in a year with a sharp unexplained leg into October ahead of the H1 FY2027 print. Base 50% as the central case. Bull cut to 20% because it needs China demand recovery, Gainline integration success and tariff containment to all go right together. The balance sheet (net debt incl. leases ~0.5x EBITDA) gives no solvency tail, so bear is not higher.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A mature, cyclical, low-SBC furniture manufacturer valued on owner FCF with a 12x terminal cap (Gordon at 10%/2% is ~12.75x, so the cap and Gordon nearly coincide). Value rests on whether the ~17-19% EBITDA margin survives China price competition and US tariffs, not on growth; at the current price the market is pricing something close to the bear case.
key_risks_to_valuation: China property-linked demand: PRC revenue -6.8% in FY2026 and 1,000+ stores closed
Section 232 furniture tariffs: duties up from ~HK$8m to ~HK$283m in FY2026; step-up to 30% upholstered scheduled January 2027
Gainline (first US manufacturing) integration and its margin dilution
Properties under development (HK$951m) realisation in a weak China property market
Unexplained ~25% share-price fall Sep-Oct 2026 ahead of H1 FY2027 results (late Nov 2026) -- possible earnings deterioration not yet in the filings
